description: A structured, round-bottomed basket bag crafted from woven straw with a tan leather trim, handle, and front patch bearing the "JACQUEMUS" logo in gold lettering. The body features a consistent herringbone weave pattern, and the leather elements are secured with gold-tone hardware, creating a chic, minimalist silhouette with a natural, bohemian aesthetic.

A large, structured basket bag crafted from woven straw with two curved tan leather handles attached by white braided cord and leather reinforcements. The body features a subtle gold-tone logo plaque at the center, and the handles are secured with gold-tone hardware. The design combines natural textures with refined detailing for a chic, resort-ready aesthetic.

A structured, wide-brimmed basket bag crafted from woven straw with contrasting black leather handles and a signature Givenchy logo plaque. The silhouette is distinctly fan-shaped with a flared, open-top design, featuring a rigid, boxy structure that maintains its shape. The material has a textured, natural woven appearance, while the hardware and trim provide a sleek, modern contrast.

A large, open-top basket bag crafted from woven straw with a distinctive diamond-patterned open-weave texture. It features two long, tan leather handles attached with leather reinforcements and a small wooden toggle detail at the center of the top rim. The silhouette is a classic wide-mouthed basket shape, designed for casual, beach-ready use.

A structured, wide-brimmed basket bag crafted from woven straw with contrasting black leather handles and a detachable shoulder strap. The body features vertical pleats for volume and a small brand patch at the center. The design combines natural texture with sleek leather accents for a chic, resort-ready silhouette.

A large, structured basket bag crafted from woven straw with two curved tan leather handles featuring contrasting white stitching. The front is adorned with a brown leather appliqué of the iconic polo player logo. The design combines natural texture with classic equestrian branding for a casual, resort-ready aesthetic.

A large, open-top basket bag crafted from woven straw with a distinctive YSL logo appliquéd in matching straw. The bag features two curved tan leather handles attached to the upper rim, offering a comfortable carry. The body is constructed with a textured, open-weave pattern that provides ventilation and a casual, resort-ready aesthetic.

A large, wide-brimmed basket bag crafted from woven straw with a structured, slightly flared silhouette. The body is framed by tan leather trim and features a top handle attached with gold-tone hardware, while a detachable gold chain strap offers shoulder or crossbody wear. The front flap is secured by a prominent gold-tone YSL logo plaque, and the base is reinforced with smooth tan leather.

A large, round-bottomed basket bag crafted from woven straw with a textured, open-weave pattern and two sturdy tan leather handles. The natural beige hue of the straw contrasts with the smooth, tan leather straps and a small branded tag hanging from one handle. The silhouette is spacious and slouchy, designed for casual, warm-weather use.

A large, open-top basket bag crafted from woven straw with a distinctive YSL logo appliquéd in the same natural tone. The bag features two sturdy tan leather handles attached to the upper rim, offering a comfortable carry. The construction showcases a consistent woven pattern with a slightly flared, rounded base, designed for casual, beach-ready use.

A classic women's leather boston bag in a rich tan hue, featuring a rounded, dome-like silhouette with two sturdy top handles attached by metal hardware and leather reinforcements. The bag showcases meticulous contrast stitching along its curved seams and a zip-top closure across the top opening. The leather exhibits a subtle patina and natural texture, suggesting quality craftsmanship and a timeless, elegant design.

A structured, dome-shaped boston  handbag in a soft pink hue, crafted from textured leather with visible stitching and two vertical straps. It features a curved top handle attached with gold-tone hardware and a detachable shoulder strap, suggesting versatility in carrying styles. The minimalist design includes a subtle brand logo embossed on the front.

A structured, dome-shaped boston handbag with a glossy red leather body and contrasting black leather accents on the base and handles. It features two curved top handles attached with silver-toned hardware and a subtle embossed "PRADA" logo on the lower right corner. The silhouette is classic and compact, with clean lines and a polished finish.

A structured, cylindrical black leather boston handbag with a vintage-inspired silhouette, featuring two curved top handles attached with brass hardware and a full-length top zip closure. The body is defined by vertical leather straps with gold-tone buckles and decorative stitching, creating a classic, tailored look. The material appears to be smooth, pebbled leather with a matte finish, and the hardware provides a subtle metallic contrast.

A rich red leather boston handbag with a classic barrel-shaped silhouette, featuring two curved top handles attached with brass hardware and a zip-around closure. The textured leather is accented with contrasting stitching and gold-tone metal accents, including D-ring attachments and a small zippered pocket on the front. The design evokes a vintage sport-luxe aesthetic with its structured form and functional detailing.

A structured, boxy brown suede handbag with a rounded rectangular silhouette and two curved top handles attached with circular leather reinforcements. The front features a debossed "MARGE SHER WOOD" logo in a matching brown tone, and a silver-toned zip closure runs along the top edge. The material has a napped texture, and the overall design is minimalist with clean lines and a vintage-inspired shape.

A structured black leather boston bag with a pebbled texture, featuring two curved top handles attached with gold-tone hardware and a zip-around closure. The front panel displays a gold-tone "VALENTINO" logo plaque, while a detachable zip-top strap with a triangular leather tag adds functional detail. The silhouette is compact and cylindrical with a rigid, boxy structure.

A structured black leather duffle bag with a pebbled texture and two curved top handles attached with gold-tone hardware. The body features vertical leather straps and a zippered opening on the side with a gold-tone zipper pull. The silhouette is cylindrical with a slightly flared base, designed for a classic, travel-ready aesthetic.

A structured, glossy brown crocodile-effect leather bucket bag, featuring a belt with a gold buckle and a detachable shoulder strap. The body features a distinctive textured croc-embossed finish and is accented by a gold-tone rectangular hardware clasp at the center. The silhouette is upright and cylindrical with a slightly flared base, creating a classic, elegant profile.

A delicate white drawstring pouch bag with a soft, gathered silhouette, featuring intricate floral lace appliqué and sparkling crystal embellishments at the center. The body is adorned with a cascading macramé fringe and suspended from two thick, twisted rope straps in a matching ivory tone. The design evokes a bohemian, artisanal aesthetic with its textured embroidery and handcrafted details.

A dark brown suede hobo bag with a slouchy, crescent-shaped silhouette, featuring long fringe detailing along the lower edges and a detachable shoulder strap attached via gold-tone hardware. The body is constructed from soft, textured suede with a curved, open-top design, and the strap attaches with gold-tone snap hooks.

A drawstring bucket bag with a cream-colored woven body featuring intricate floral embroidery in earthy tones and a gold-tone LV logo. The bag is adorned with a long fringe of brown cord at the base and two braided leather tassel handles. The drawstring closure is secured with a brown leather strap, and the overall design evokes a bohemian, artisanal aesthetic.

A compact, vertically oriented drawstring pouch crafted from woven raffia in a deep navy hue, featuring a central granny square embellishment in contrasting beige and blue tones. The brand name "LOEWE" is embroidered in matching blue thread below the patterned panel, while a thin navy cord strap with a silver-toned bead provides shoulder or crossbody wear. The design combines bohemian textile techniques with minimalist branding in a small, functional silhouette.

A structured navy blue drawstring bag with a cylindrical body and a gathered top closure secured by black braided cords ending in decorative tassels. The upper portion is crafted from a satin-like material with a subtle sheen, while the lower section is made of a matte navy fabric, creating a two-tone effect. The black cords are threaded through a gathered opening, forming a drawstring closure that cinches the top.

A structured brown leather bucket bag with a drawstring closure featuring a decorative tassel and gold-tone hardware. The bag has a rounded, cylindrical silhouette with a detachable top handle and a matching shoulder strap, accented by a stitched leather base and clean, minimalist detailing.

A structured, deep green leather shoulder bag featuring a distinctive diamond-patterned intrecciato weave. The bag has a zip-top closure with gold-tone hardware and is equipped with a detachable, knotted leather strap for crossbody wear. The design combines classic craftsmanship with a modern, compact silhouette.

A structured, boxy smal crossbody bag in a muted olive green hue, crafted from textured leather with a distinctive diamond-patterned woven construction. The bag features a top zip closure with a gold-tone pull and is equipped with a matching woven rope strap knotted at the ends. The design emphasizes clean lines and a minimalist aesthetic with subtle hardware accents.

A structured, rectangular shoulder bag in deep burgundy velvet with contrasting black leather trim and a curved top handle. The body features a zip-top closure with gold-tone hardware and a subtle embossed brand logo at the bottom center. The design combines soft velvet texture with sleek leather accents for a refined, contemporary look.

A compact, structured purple leather bag featuring the signature intrecciato woven pattern in a boxy, slightly rounded rectangular silhouette. It is equipped with a matching purple braided leather strap attached via gold-tone hardware, creating a cohesive and elegant look. The design emphasizes clean lines and a luxurious, handcrafted texture.

A structured, square-shaped black leather bag with a glossy finish and visible stitching details. It features a detachable shoulder strap with a silver-toned buckle, a top zip closure, and a front zippered pocket. The bag has a slightly worn, vintage aesthetic with natural leather texture and a minimalist design.

A structured, rectangular clutch with a glossy orange crocodile-effect leather finish and a top zip closure. The bag features a minimalist design with a subtle brand logo at the bottom center and a metallic zipper pull. The surface texture mimics crocodile skin with distinct scale patterns, giving it a luxurious and bold appearance.

A sleek, rectangular black leather clutch featuring a glossy crocodile-effect texture and a top zip closure with a gold-tone pull. The minimalist design includes a subtle embossed brand name at the bottom center, emphasizing clean lines and a luxurious, animal-print finish.

A sleek, rectangular black crocodile-effect leather clutch featuring a prominent, ornate silver-toned skull and crossbones embellishment at the center. The textured leather has a glossy finish and is secured by a central clasp mechanism. The design is bold and statement-making, combining animal print with edgy metallic detailing.

A rectangular woven clutch with a vibrant, multicolored raffia-like texture and decorative white circular embellishments with black polka dots. The edges are finished with colorful fringes, and it features a brown leather wrist strap for secure carrying. The design combines bohemian flair with artisanal craftsmanship.

A rectangular black woven raffia clutch featuring a decorative pattern of silver-toned circular embellishments arranged in a diamond grid. The edges are finished with black fringe, and it is equipped with a thin black leather wrist strap for secure carrying. The textured weave and metallic accents create a bohemian-chic aesthetic.

A rectangular black velvet clutch featuring a patchwork design of six distinct embossed damask patterns in a contrasting grey tone. The bag has a full-length gold-toned zipper closure across the top and is attached to a detachable black leather wrist strap with a gold-tone clasp. A small brand tag reading "MY-BEST BAG FIRENZE" is visible at the center.

A sleek, rectangular black sequin clutch with a metallic gold-tone clasp closure. The body is fully covered in densely applied black sequins creating a shimmering, textured surface, with a smooth black leather trim along the top edge. The design is minimalist and elegant, emphasizing sparkle and a structured silhouette.

A structured, trapezoidal leather briefcase in rich brown with contrasting tan stitching and gold-tone hardware, featuring a top handle, front flap pocket with a keyhole lock; hinged frame top with a central clasp, and a brand plaque. The body has a slightly slouchy, padded silhouette with visible seams.

A structured, vintage-inspired leather handbag in a rich burgundy hue, featuring a prominent brass frame closure with rivets and a matching leather top handle. The body has a slightly slouchy, trapezoidal silhouette with visible stitching and a small leather flap at the top center. The hardware is antiqued brass, and the brand name is embossed on the front.

A structured, orange leather handbag with a vintage-inspired design featuring a prominent brass frame closure adorned with rivets and two curved top handles. The bag has a slightly slouchy, trapezoidal silhouette with visible stitching and a subtle brand imprint on the front. The hardware is gold-toned, and the overall aesthetic suggests a classic, timeless style with a touch of industrial detailing.

A structured, vibrant red leather handbag with a distinctive brass frame closure and matching top handle. The bag features a slightly slouchy, trapezoidal silhouette with visible stitching and a subtle brand imprint on the front. Gold-tone hardware accents the frame, handle attachments, and side zip pulls, contributing to its classic, slightly vintage aesthetic.

A structured, glossy black leather handbag with a classic doctor's bag silhouette, featuring a curved top handle, a central metal clasp closure, and a rigid, boxy frame. The body is defined by sharp seams and a slightly flared base, with a minimalist aesthetic accented by silver-toned hardware.

A navy blue duffle bag with vertical striped canvas detailing and contrasting white, red, and blue webbing trim. Constructed with leather handles and a detachable shoulder strap featuring a metal buckle, it has a structured cylindrical silhouette with a top zip closure and red zipper pulls. The design combines sport-luxe aesthetics with functional travel elements.

A sleek, cylindrical black leather duffle bag with a pebbled texture, featuring two short top handles secured with silver-toned hardware and a detachable black web strap with a buckle. The body has a structured, barrel-like silhouette with a flat base for standing upright, and the hardware includes a small logo plaque at the top center.

A large cylindrical duffle bag with a repeating FF logo pattern in beige and black on a textured fabric body, featuring two black leather top handles attached with silver-tone hardware and a zip-top closure. The silhouette is structured with a slightly flared base, and the material appears to be a durable woven textile with leather accents.

A large, structured duffle bag with a bold leopard print on a beige-toned canvas base, featuring two black leather top handles and a zip-top closure. The bag has a rigid, barrel-like silhouette with a black leather FENDI logo plaque centered on the front. The material appears to be durable canvas with contrasting black leather trim and hardware.

A soft elongated tan leather shoulder bag with open top, a soft, slouchy silhouette and two curved top handles. The bag features visible contrast stitching along the handle attachments and a small leather tag with the "Polo" logo. The design is minimalist with a clean, unadorned front and a subtle brand imprint at the base.

A minimalist envelope clutch with a matte tan finish, crafted from textured suede-like material with a subtle woven pattern. The design features a classic flap closure that folds over the front, secured by a hidden magnetic or snap fastening. The silhouette is a clean, unadorned rectangle with soft, unstructured edges, emphasizing a sleek and understated aesthetic.

A minimalist envelope clutch with a matte brown suede finish, featuring a classic flap closure secured by a subtle silver-toned hardware detail at the top left corner. The edges are neatly stitched with contrasting thread, enhancing its clean, structured silhouette.

A sleek, rectangular black clutch with a glossy crocodile-effect leather finish and a prominent silver-tone YSL logo plaque centered on the envelope-style flap. The minimalist silhouette features clean lines and a smooth, reflective surface that catches the light, emphasizing its luxurious texture and iconic branding.

A structured, rectangular envelope clutch in rich brown crocodile-effect leather, featuring a prominent gold-tone YSL logo plaque centered on the flap. The textured surface mimics natural crocodile skin with a glossy finish, while the flap closure provides a clean, minimalist silhouette.

A minimalist mustard-yellow leather envelope clutch with a structured, rectangular silhouette and a prominent V-shaped flap closure. The bag features clean, contrasting stitching along the flap edges and a subtle embossed brand name at the center. The material has a soft, slightly textured finish, and the overall design emphasizes clean lines and understated elegance.

A sleek, metallic silver envelope clutch with a structured rectangular silhouette and a pebbled leather texture. The flap closure is secured with precise contrast stitching, and the brand name "CARVELA" is subtly embossed in the center. The minimalist design emphasizes clean lines and a reflective, polished finish.

A striking red leather clutch featuring a sculpted, wavy ribbed texture created by layered horizontal leather strips. The structured, rectangular silhouette is accented by a matching leather wrist strap attached to the top edge. The design emphasizes bold color and dimensional craftsmanship with a minimalist, modern aesthetic.

A vibrant red leather clutch with a structured, elongated rectangular silhouette featuring a distinctive gold-tone angular clasp and a decorative brass plaque engraved with "Love" alongside a tree-of-life motif. The clutch has visible stitching along its edges and a minimalist, elegant design with metallic hardware accents.

A minimalist beige leather envelope clutch featuring a prominent gold-tone YSL logo plaque centered on the flap. The textured leather has a pebbled finish and is secured by a front-flap closure with visible stitching along the edges. The design is clean and classic, emphasizing brand identity through the iconic hardware.

A structured black leather envelope clutch with a prominent silver-tone YSL logo plaque centered on the flap. The pebbled leather texture and clean, precise stitching define its minimalist aesthetic. The envelope-style closure with a diagonal flap creates a classic, elegant silhouette.

A sleek, crescent-moon shaped hobo bag crafted from black suede with a distinctive, sculpted gold-tone metal handle that curves over the top. The handle is attached via gold hardware and leather straps, creating a bold, statement-making silhouette. The bag features a minimalist, unstructured body with visible stitching along the curved edge.

A minimalist hobo bag featuring a textured ivory fabric with contrasting black leather trim along the curved opening and a single black leather shoulder strap. The silhouette is soft and slouchy with a rounded bottom, suggesting a casual, comfortable wear. The material has a subtle, organic marbled texture, and the construction emphasizes clean lines and a monochromatic color palette.

A tan suede hobo bag featuring a curved, half-moon silhouette with extensive fringe detailing along the lower edge. The bag is constructed with a single shoulder strap attached via gold-tone hardware and a top zip closure. The fringe is created from suede lacing, adding texture and movement to the design.

A structured, rounded hobo-style bag with a distinctive woven jacquard pattern in gradient shades of peach, rust, and cream. The body features a single wide, circular top handle made of smooth black leather, contrasting with the textured fabric. The silhouette is soft and slouchy with a curved, open-top design, suggesting a casual yet chic aesthetic.

A beige saffiano leather hobo bag with a curved, slouchy silhouette featuring a gold-tone chain strap attached to a beige web strap. The front is adorned with a triangular Prada logo plaque, and the bag includes a detachable zip-top pouch. The structured yet soft body has a top zip closure and a minimalist, elegant aesthetic.

A sleek, curved black leather hobo shoulder bag with a prominent gold-tone chain strap and a matching detachable strap. The body features a top zip closure and a triangular Prada logo plaque in gold-tone hardware. The design combines structured silhouette with luxurious metallic accents for a chic, minimalist aesthetic.

A minimalist black leather underarm shoulder bag with a structured, slightly flared trapezoidal silhouette and a braided leather strap. The strap is attached to a decorative black tassel at the side, adding a textural contrast. The bag features clean, precise stitching and a smooth, matte leather finish with no visible hardware or closure.

A structured, glossy green leather hobo bag featuring a distinctive woven intrecciato pattern across its entire surface, including the braided shoulder strap. The body has a soft, slouchy crescent silhouette with a curved, open-top design. The rich emerald hue and textured weave create a luxurious, artisanal appearance.

A structured hobo bag featuring a distinctive intrecciato woven leather body in a rich brown hue, with a matching braided leather handle and drawstring closure at the base. The interior reveals a contrasting light beige cotton lining, and the construction highlights clean, precise stitching throughout. The design combines artisanal weaving with a classic hobo silhouette for a luxurious, handcrafted aesthetic.

A structured, rectangular brown leather messenger bag with a textured, slightly worn finish and contrasting tan stitching. It features a wide adjustable shoulder strap with a brass buckle and metal hardware accents at the attachment points. The bag has a flap closure secured by a buckle strap, giving it a classic, utilitarian silhouette.

A structured, rectangular flap shoulder bag in a deep burgundy hue, crafted from textured canvas with contrasting tan leather trim and a distinctive X-stitched flap closure secured by two silver-toned snap buttons. The bag features a wide, adjustable web strap for crossbody wear and zippered compartments on the sides and front, with visible stitching detailing throughout.

A sleek, structured black leather shoulder bag with a pebbled texture and a detachable shoulder strap. The bag features a full-length top zip closure and a subtle embossed brand logo on the front. The design is minimalist with clean lines and silver-toned hardware, emphasizing functionality and a classic, professional silhouette.

A structured, rectangular brown suede messenger bag with a flap closure and adjustable shoulder strap. The strap features embossed branding, and the bag has a minimalist design with a small logo plaque at the bottom center. The material has a distressed, mottled texture, and the construction includes visible stitching and metal hardware.

A structured, medium-sized brown leather messenger bag with a flap closure and adjustable shoulder strap. The leather exhibits a distressed, vintage finish with visible grain and natural wear patterns. The bag features a top zip opening, a detachable strap with a brass buckle, and a small brand patch on the lower right corner. The construction includes visible stitching along the flap and body seams.

A structured, medium-sized brown leather messenger bag with a pebbled texture and contrasting light stitching. It features a flap-over front closure with a zippered pocket above, a detachable web strap with metal buckle, and a top handle. The brand name is subtly embossed on the lower front panel.

A structured black leather messenger bag with a flap closure and adjustable shoulder strap. The pebbled leather texture and minimalist design feature a subtle embossed logo on the flap. The bag has a classic upright silhouette with clean lines and silver-toned hardware.

A structured, dark brown leather messenger bag with a flap closure and a detachable shoulder strap. The bag features visible stitching along the central seam and a branded leather patch on the front flap. The material shows natural leather texture with a slightly worn, vintage finish.

A structured, rectangular messenger in a muted grey palette, featuring a front flap closure over a patchwork panel design with contrasting black leather accents. The bag is constructed from smooth leather with visible stitching and includes a detachable shoulder strap. A vertical brand name plaque and a metallic logo plate add minimalist branding details.

A structured, medium-sized brown leather messenger bag with a pebbled texture and a flap closure secured by a silver-toned turn-lock clasp. The bag features a detachable shoulder strap with a buckle and a top handle for carrying. The design includes visible stitching and a minimalist aesthetic with no additional embellishments.

A structured, medium-sized brown leather flap shoulder bag with a textured pebbled finish and a flap closure secured by a brass buckle and leather strap. The bag features a detachable shoulder strap with gold-tone hardware and a brand plaque at the base. The silhouette is upright and rectangular with a slightly flared bottom, conveying a classic, tailored menswear-inspired aesthetic.

A structured, medium-sized brown leather messenger bag with a classic flap-over front secured by a brass buckle strap. The bag features visible stitching, a zippered side pocket, and a textured leather finish with natural creasing and patina. The design includes a detachable shoulder strap and a subtle brand stamp on the lower right corner.

A glossy, pearlescent beige oval-shaped minaudiere with a sculpted white shell-like clasp and a delicate gold-toned chain strap. The surface features a swirling, marbled texture that catches the light, giving it a luxurious, organic sheen. The minimalist design emphasizes the unique material and sculptural form.

A compact, structured boxy minaudiere with a textured woven metallic gold body and a matching chain strap. The bag features a curved top handle with crystal embellishments and a central crystal-encrusted clasp, framed by gold-tone hardware. The design combines a rigid, geometric silhouette with glamorous embellishments for evening wear.

A compact, heart-shaped minaudiere with a textured silver metallic finish and a prominent crystal-encrusted kiss-lock clasp. The bag features a curved gold-tone metal frame and a matching arched top handle, creating a vintage-inspired silhouette with a glamorous, evening-ready aesthetic.

A structured, elongated rectangular minaudiere with a matte beige suede-like finish, featuring a prominent gold-toned metallic leaf-shaped clasp at the center. The bag is equipped with a gold chain strap attached via metal rings, suggesting a convertible design for shoulder or crossbody wear. The silhouette is sleek and minimalist, emphasizing the sculptural leaf embellishment as the primary design focal point.

A glamorous, gold-toned minaudiere featuring a textured, glittery surface with an intricate, scalloped metal frame encircling each panel. The body is adorned with small crystal accents at the frame intersections and a prominent crystal-encrusted clasp at the top. A delicate gold chain strap is attached, suggesting it can be worn as a crossbody or shoulder bag.

A compact, rigid rectangular box minaudiere with a textured grey surface covered in sparkling silver sequins. The bag features a gold-tone metal frame with a decorative dome-shaped clasp at the top and a delicate gold chain strap attached to the sides. The design is embellished with a subtle, all-over sequin pattern that catches the light, creating a glamorous, evening-ready aesthetic.

A rectangular minaudiere with a structured, rigid frame and a hinged clasp closure. The body is covered in a vibrant, zigzag pattern of multicolored beads in shades of purple, blue, and silver, set against a dark background. It features a delicate gold-tone chain strap attached to the sides and a decorative, beaded dome-shaped clasp at the top center.

A structured, rectangular minaudiere with a glossy, marbled beige and cream resin-like finish. It features a gold-tone metal frame closure and is attached to a delicate gold chain strap, allowing it to be worn as a crossbody or shoulder bag. The surface has a subtle, organic swirling pattern that mimics natural stone or wood grain.

A structured pouch with a herringbone weave in ivory and gold-toned threads, framed by a gold-tone metal kiss-lock clasp and a matching gold-toned mesh trim along the top edge. The body features a rigid, geometric silhouette with a slightly flared base, crafted from woven plant-fibre with a subtle sheen.

A structured, black intrecciato leather pouch with a distinctive woven diamond pattern and a slightly slouchy, soft silhouette. The surface is uniformly textured from the interlaced leather strips, creating a rich, tactile finish. The closure is a subtle, integrated flap with a small black tab at the top center.

A structured, dome-shaped pouch crafted from rich tan leather with a distinctive diamond-patterned intrecciato weave. The body features a gathered, drawstring closure at the top, creating a soft, slouchy silhouette, and is suspended by two curved leather handles attached to the gathered opening. The craftsmanship highlights the intricate woven texture and supple leather finish.

A rich burgundy velvet pouch with a drawstring closure and a matching red tassel hanging from a central black bead. The soft, plush velvet material has a gathered top with visible drawstrings, creating a rounded, slouchy silhouette. The tassel adds a decorative, traditional element, suggesting use as a decorative or ceremonial accessory.

A rich burgundy velvet pouch with a gathered, pleated silhouette and a silver-toned kiss-lock clasp adorned with two pinkish rose quartz spheres. The bag features a detachable chain strap and a structured, rounded rectangular body with a soft, plush texture. The metallic hardware provides a contrasting sheen against the deep, velvety fabric.

A structured, glossy black crocodile-effect patent leather pouch with a rigid gold-tone metal frame closure and a matching gold-tone brand plaque on the top edge. The body features a subtle sheen and a slightly flared, trapezoidal silhouette with a smooth, unadorned front surface.

A structured, boxy black leather pouch with a prominent crocodile-effect texture and a central circular silver-toned hardware clasp. The silhouette is rigid and rectangular with a slightly curved top edge, featuring a minimalist design with no visible handles or straps. The surface is uniformly textured, emphasizing a luxurious, animal-leather aesthetic.

A structured, glossy emerald green crocodile-effect leather pouch with a curved, dome-like silhouette and a silver-toned chain strap. The bag features a distinctive curved top handle and a circular logo plaque attached to the chain. The surface has a textured, scaled crocodile pattern with a subtle sheen, and the overall design is compact and elegant with a vintage-inspired shape.

A small, structured pouch with a gathered, dome-like silhouette crafted from a textured, glitter-embellished black fabric. It features a prominent gold-tone chain strap attached via a circular logo tag and a top zip closure. The material has a subtle sheen and scattered metallic flecks, giving it a luxurious, evening-ready appearance.

A drawstring pouch bag featuring a vibrant geometric pattern in shades of rust, orange, and purple on a dark background. Constructed from a woven fabric with a gathered top closure secured by black drawstrings ending in gold-tone hardware. The design incorporates circular and diamond motifs with a star-like center in each panel, creating a bold, tribal-inspired aesthetic.

A structured, sequined pouch with a distinctive sculptural silver spoon handle. The body is covered in densely applied silver and black sequins creating a shimmering, textured surface. The handle is a large, polished metal spoon with a curved, organic shape, attached to the top of the bag by silver hardware.

A compact, structured pouch featuring a distinctive woven leather construction in a deep burgundy hue, with a matching thin strap for shoulder or crossbody wear. The body is formed from interlaced leather strips creating a textured, basket-weave pattern that defines its silhouette. The design is minimalist, focusing on the intricate craftsmanship and rich color of the material.

A tan leather saddle bag with a curved, half-moon silhouette featuring a central bow detail on the flap. Constructed from pebbled leather with a detachable chain strap attached via gold-tone hardware, the bag has a structured, elegant profile with visible stitching and a minimalist aesthetic.

A structured, dark brown leather saddle bag with a curved, half-moon silhouette and a front flap secured by a tassel detail. The bag features a detachable shoulder strap with gold-tone hardware and a chain accent, complemented by a matching adjustable strap for crossbody wear. The pebbled leather texture and metallic hardware contribute to a classic, equestrian-inspired aesthetic.

A tan leather saddle bag with a curved, half-moon silhouette featuring a prominent front flap secured by a buckle and a detachable shoulder strap. The bag showcases contrasting stitching, a suede panel on the lower front, and gold-tone hardware including buckles and D-rings. The design emphasizes equestrian-inspired detailing with a structured, well-defined shape.

A sleek, curved black leather saddle bag with a minimalist silhouette, featuring a detachable shoulder strap with a gold-tone buckle and a front zippered pocket. The bag has a pebbled leather texture and gold-tone hardware accents, including zippers and a small brand logo plaque at the base.

A compact, structured saddle bag in a muted teal-green hue, crafted from textured leather with a curved, half-moon silhouette. It features a flap closure secured by a decorative tassel detail and is equipped with a detachable shoulder strap attached via gold-tone hardware. The design combines classic equestrian-inspired shape with modern minimalist detailing.

A structured, tan leather hobo bag with a curved, crescent-shaped silhouette and contrasting black trim. It features a detachable shoulder strap attached via silver-toned hardware and a distinctive D-ring buckle detail on the front. The bag has a minimalist aesthetic with clean stitching and a smooth leather finish.

A structured, glossy black crocodile-effect leather top handle bag featuring a distinctive curved bamboo handle and a zip-top closure. The bag has a slouchy, asymmetrical silhouette with visible stitching details and a patent-like sheen on the textured leather.
